name: Club D
source:
It was a day like any other for the main protagonist, an ordinary high school boy called Takayuki Hamano. But while pursuing a cat, he was forcefully asked to get into the "Club D" by its four female members. The club is supposed to help solve mysteries, as any school detective club would do.
But behind that normality, the girls wanted to hide some secrets...
